name: Venezuela
description: Follow Venezuela, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: A Bitter White House Feud, Even by Trump-Era Standards: Alina Mildon and Richard Grenell
changes.summary: Two Trump allies — Alina Habba Mildon and Richard Grenell — are locked in a raging dispute that has its roots in the battle for a share of the spoils in Venezuela.

changes.title: Trump Ally Harold Hamm Strikes Venezuela Oil Deal
changes.summary: Mr. Hamm’s company, Continental Resources, has signed a preliminary deal with Venezuela’s state-owned oil company to develop and produce oil.

changes.title: U.S.-Venezuela oil deal puts opposition in a political bind
changes.summary: Venezuelan opposition members are uneasy with new oil deals with the U.S., worried that agreements with authoritarian regime in Caracas could undermine democratic progress.

changes.title: U.S.-Venezuela oil deal won't reduce domestic gasoline prices anytime soon, experts say
changes.summary: Oil experts told PolitiFact gains for consumers will not materialize any time soon, and would likely take years — long after November's midterm elections.

changes.title: The U.S. Wants the Oil From These 17 Venezuelan Fields
changes.summary: A private oil company has struck a deal with the Trump administration to develop 17 areas in Venezuela, an effort that experts say will take years and billions of dollars.

changes.title: Morning News Brief
changes.summary: Exodus of experienced military leadership continues in the Pentagon, Trump touts Venezuela oil deal as critics question legality, the jury is deadlocked in the trial of Lindsay Clancy.

changes.title: Ex-National Security Council director on administration's plan for Venezuela oil
changes.summary: NPR's Michel Martin asks former Obama administration official Benjamin Gedan {guh-DAN} about the viability of the Trump administration's plan for Venezuelan oil.

changes.title: Critics question legality of Venezuela oil deals
changes.summary: Chevron's $7 billion Venezuela bet deepens U.S. ties to the country's oil industry. Critics say the deal poses risks to democracy and could fuel discontent over Washington's embrace of the government.

changes.title: Chevron Expansion in Venezuela Extends U.S. Influence Over Oil Riches
changes.summary: The U.S. energy giant, which stayed in the country after other Western companies left, will invest $7 billion in the country to more than double its production there.

changes.title: U.S. oil giant Chevron confirms it will expand operations in Venezuela
changes.summary: Oil giant Chevron confirmed that it will expand operations in Venezuela after President Donald Trump announced an ambitious deal to develop the nation's oil reserves and give the Pentagon a stake in the profits.
